output.reason: [ev-c3fa8260181b] says only that the chart now allows an `enabled` value to be set so a parent chart can toggle cert-manager as a dependency. The validators confirm that `enabled` is a new key, absent in v1.16.0 and present in v1.17.0 [ev-717ddb6f40cd][ev-fdc96eee87bf]. Nothing in the evidence says that environments setting `enabled: false` see a changed outcome, so the equals-false condition assumes a behavior the evidence does not state. The environments that touch this addition are the ones that set the key, so exposure should be values-key `enabled` set.

correction.statement: The cert-manager 1.17.0 Helm chart adds an `enabled` value so cert-manager can be toggled when used as a chart dependency; environments that set `enabled` in their values touch this new key.
